headline: Hafnia Abandons Takeover Bid for Torm, Plans Capital Distribution
summary: Product tanker giant Hafnia dropped its acquisition attempt for Danish peer Torm after negotiations stalled, announcing plans to return billions in capital to shareholders.
why: Hafnia and Torm are leading global clean petroleum product tanker operators. M&A dynamics directly influence market capacity and spot shipping freight rates.

impacts.name: Hafnia
impacts.why: Hafnia announced plans to return excess capital to shareholders after halting the buyout.
